# A personalized travel magazine page

[All prompts](../README.md#collection) · [中文](#中文) · [Open Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com)

Combine a traveler reference, destination, photos, and dense editorial typography on one page.

## Prompt



```text
Create a vertical 9:16 travel-magazine page about [DESTINATION]. Blend the attached person naturally into the destination photography. Include a clear headline, short travel tips, recommendations, and photo captions. Use the whole page with a readable editorial hierarchy. Check every visible word.
```

## Required inputs

- A person reference and a destination. Replace the bracketed placeholder.

## Notes

- This condensed adaptation adds an explicit text-review step. The complete creator prompt is in the linked author reply.
- Generated travel details need factual checking before publication.

## 中文

### 个性化旅行杂志页

将旅行者参考图、目的地、照片和密集编辑排版组合为一页。

预览是原作者帖中的示例，并非本仓库使用下方提示词重新生成的结果。

### 提示词



```text
制作一张介绍 [目的地] 的 9:16 竖版旅行杂志页。把附件人物自然融入目的地照片，加入清晰标题、简短旅行提示、推荐和图片说明。充分利用版面，保证编辑层级清晰，并检查所有可见文字。
```

### 输入要求

- 人物参考图与目的地；替换方括号占位符。
